Remark
[Consequences of the essentiality hypotheses] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0251 1. Remark 8.13\group dilations-of-singularities

Any smooth limit of a globally curvature essential sequence formed by the parabolic dilations below has curvature bounded by a function of time, and the limit is complete. A smooth limit of a locally curvature essential sequence has bounded curvature on a unit metric ball for times $-1\le t\le 0$.
